# FAIL

## Requirement Summary

"DX Coil Height must be set to the sum of all Cooling Circuit Heights (in inches), recalculated immediately after any height edit, with an empty circuit list resulting in 0 inches. Inputs are pre‑validated and no other behavior is required."

## Reviewer Findings

- F1 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "Unclear whether the recalculation should be triggered by edits to any Cooling Circuit Height, edits to DX Coil Height itself, or both." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on which edits should trigger the recalculation."
- F2 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "No rounding or precision rules are specified for the sum of heights." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on rounding and precision requirements for the summed height."
- F3 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The ticket does not specify whether only active/enabled Cooling Circuits should be included in the sum." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on whether inactive or disabled Cooling Circuits should be excluded from the sum."
- F4 | MEDIUM | OPEN_AMBIGUITY | "The mechanism for the immediate recalculation (e.g., UI event, backend process) is not defined." | "Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the required mechanism for triggering the immediate recalculation."

## Open Ambiguities

- /ambiguities/0 | "It is unclear whether the recalculation should be triggered by edits to any Cooling Circuit Height, edits to DX Coil Height itself, or both."
- /ambiguities/1 | "No rounding or precision rules are specified for the sum of heights."
- /ambiguities/2 | "The ticket does not specify whether only active/enabled Cooling Circuits should be included in the sum."
- /ambiguities/3 | "The mechanism for the immediate recalculation (e.g., UI event, backend process) is not defined."

## Final Disposition

FAIL
